# @surfaces-ui/spec

Component catalog, A2UI surface model and React renderer for agent-generated UI.

Agent-generated UI: the component catalog, the A2UI surface model, the agent prompt generated from the catalog, and `SurfaceView`, which draws what an agent sends after checking it against the catalog. Nothing outside the catalog is drawn.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/spec react react-dom
```

`react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies: your app provides them.

## Use

```tsx
import { analyticsCatalog } from "@surfaces-ui/spec";
import { SurfaceView, analyticsRenderers, useSurfaces } from "@surfaces-ui/spec/react";

const { surfaces, apply } = useSurfaces(analyticsCatalog);
// apply(message) for each A2UI message as it arrives from the agent
<SurfaceView surface={surfaces.main} catalog={analyticsCatalog} renderers={analyticsRenderers} onAction={sendToAgent} />;
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.

Every Surfaces UI package is released at the same version; install them all at that one version, since mixing releases is not supported.
